name: watch-video-like-human
description: Watch any video the user can legitimately play - a local file, a download, in-browser extraction, or screen recording - and report honestly what was actually seen, heard or only read.

interface.shortDescription: Give the agent a video and get an answer that says what was really seen, heard or only read.
interface.longDescription: Four routes to the material (a file you have, a permitted download, in-browser caption and frame extraction, screen plus loopback recording), keyframes with real timestamps, full-transcript reading, region crops, and an evidence manifest that turns into a disclosure block at the top of every answer.
defaultPrompt: Watch this video and tell me what happens around 02:30: <path or URL>
Take complete study notes from this lecture recording: <path>
Read the captions of <URL> and summarize it - no download needed
